hint_ladder: Say that someone tries hard at something.
Use make with an effort, and effort to with a base verb after it.
Start with the words: You should make an ___ to speak English every day.
teaching_content.reveal_form: You should make an effort to speak English every day.
canonical_forms: You should make an effort to speak English every day.
alternative_realizations: She made a real effort to finish on time.
